scripts.script:
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local assetId = 78895317546665

local success, model = pcall(function()
    return InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId)
end)

if success and model then
    -- The loaded asset is a Model or Folder, parent its children to Workspace
    for i, child in model:GetChildren() do
        child.Parent = Workspace
    end
    model:Destroy() -- Clean up the container
else
    warn("Failed to load model with asset ID:", assetId)
end
